tip: Insider tip: Target the low early flows on Taneycomo before generation increases. Drift or wade seams and current breaks with 2-lb test and a Berkley Pink PowerWorm, 1/16-oz marabou micro jig (black/sculpin/olive with orange head), or a zebra midge (#16-20) under an indicator.
